technicalFindings.finding: All 48 per-version 900ms glm-5.3-flash group shared-knowledge write-decision requests timed out, 144/144 across the three artifacts. This is interpretGroupKnowledgeInstruction, not the primary intent model and not all 20-second fact-extraction calls.
technicalFindings.limits: The recorded error rounds 900ms to one second; the evidence does not isolate provider queueing, network, request format or model throughput as the cause.

technicalFindings.finding: Final candidate reports 76 successful extraction entries (69 written=0, seven with writes), four failures (two 20-second transport errors, two HTTP-200 invalid-output) and 16 throttled group entries. Four failed batches retain source utterance, source timestamp and personaSource at the last observed turn, with attempts=1 and retryExhausted=false. Later independent messages succeed.
technicalFindings.limits: Raw memory-model response bodies were not retained; invalid-output cannot be narrowed further. Success with zero writes is not proof of a committed fact or exact raw []. Snapshot exports in-memory buffers, not durable pending documents. No real-model retry exhaustion or process-restart test occurs.

technicalFindings.finding: Both candidates pass 3/3 date-storage and 3/3 memory-only follow-up recalls. Final exam facts preserve at=1792079990000 and event date 2026-10-16.
technicalFindings.detail: Final eventAt=1792166390000 is 2026-10-16T23:59:50+08:00, a date anchor retaining the original time; it does not resolve the stated morning hour. All three final follow-up replies say 明天上午 with absolute 10月16号.
technicalFindings.limits: The scenario follow-up clock is 2026-10-16T00:02:00+08:00 but the global runtime and recall clock remain real 2026-10-15 evening, so consistent cross-midnight today/tomorrow generation was not tested.

technicalFindings.finding: Both candidates retain complete personaSource on 3/3 milk-preference facts and expose old 岚 source attribution on 6/6 later recalls after bot or persona-version switches. Viewer scope changes correctly and prior self-reply source is absent on those memory-only turns.
technicalFindings.limits: This exercises public-fact provenance and those switches; it is not exhaustive proof for all feedback/profile caches, complete PersonaSnapshot fields or every episodic first-person path.

technicalFindings.finding: Final fault scenario preserves burning-odor and disconnected-power conditions for all 6/6 turns, uses serious_answer/help_request/reasoning with playfulness off, and permits only static_observation. Three follow-up replies refuse user power-on. Baseline and initial candidate lost the serious plan on all three follow-ups, although their actual replies also advised against power-on.
technicalFindings.limits: This is plan and condition-continuity evidence, not an expert electrical safety certification; some wording overstates diagnosis certainty.

technicalFindings.finding: Final 18 remaining check failures are all kind: biscuit follow-ups six, dated recall three, persona-switch first follow-up three and comfort six.
technicalFindings.limits: Kind mismatch is not equivalent to an erroneous final answer: biscuit replies continue the joke and comfort replies remain comforting. It still shows shared social classification does not cover all intended acts.

technicalFindings.finding: Final third-person sample 2 repeats the user question almost verbatim while all its structural checks pass. Baseline partial-forward replies treat node 80 as the complete final message while their structural checks also pass. Final forward replies correctly disclose the 80-of-at-least-85 limit.
technicalFindings.limits: Long-term-recall checks search a keyword; event-date checks accept any matching fact; personaProjection checks name/tone/speechStyle only. None is a general semantic-quality or complete-persona acceptance metric.

technicalFindings.finding: Final overall reply p95 is 31425ms, versus baseline 12739ms and initial candidate 12458ms; the final high-reasoning fault turns account for the long tail. Final low-reasoning p95 is 7148ms.
technicalFindings.limits: Memory-drain time follows reply delivery and cannot be represented as user reply waiting. Total offline-turn elapsed time includes memory settling. This experiment does not demonstrate overall speedup.
